visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark, styled hair and wearing a navy blue polo shirt with white and yellow trim stands against a plain white wall. He is holding an orange-cased iPhone and looking directly into the camera with an excited expression while talking. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up of the iPhone screen, displaying a setup interface for 'Apple Intelligence' in Traditional Chinese. The man continues to hold the phone, pointing out the interface as he speaks. (3) The man demonstrates the 'Visual Intelligence' feature by pointing the phone at a printed magazine page titled 'AIR SPACE'. The screen shows text being summarized and translated with white and purple overlays appearing over the physical text. (4) The scene shifts to the man holding a small pink product box for 'EUTHYMOL' mints. He points the phone at the box, and the screen shows a visual search result page with various shopping links and product images from retailers like Amazon and Shopee. (5) The man shows the phone connecting to ChatGPT to analyze the product. A text prompt 'What is this?' is entered, and a detailed description of the mints appears in Traditional Chinese on the interface. (6) The video transitions to show the man using a 'Writing Tools' feature on the phone. He uses voice input to request a work leave email, and the phone automatically generates a formal draft in a text editor. (7) A messaging interface is shown where Spanish text is being translated in real-time to Traditional Chinese subtitles within the chat bubble. (8) The man returns to the eye-level shot, smiling broadly and pointing at the camera, gesturing for viewers to update their systems as the video ends.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-energy male voice begins speaking in Traditional Chinese with an excited, bright tone. An upbeat, major-key electronic pop BGM starts immediately with a strong, driving four-on-the-floor beat and bright synth textures. (2) A 'pop' SFX triggers as the speaker emphasizes the AI update. The BGM maintains its steady tempo of approximately 125 BPM. The vocal delivery is fast-paced, with frequent rising intonations indicating enthusiasm. (3) A digital 'ding' SFX occurs as the 'Visual Intelligence' feature is demonstrated on screen. The speaker's voice remains consistently loud and clear, sitting prominently above the BGM mix. (4) A 'whoosh' transition sound effect marks a shift in the demonstration scenes. The BGM remains continuous and energetic. The speaker uses exaggerated pitch shifts to maintain viewer engagement during the technical walkthrough. (5) A quick 'pop' SFX reinforces the interactive element of the phone screen demonstration while the speaker asks a rhetorical question. (6) Final phase: The speaker delivers a final call to action with high vocal dominance and a joyful valence. The BGM maintains its energy until the final frame where it cuts out.
